overview.description: The Canary Staked TRX ETF (TRXS) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long trx, short usd currency. The Trusts primary investment objective is to seek to provide exposure to the price of TRX held by the Trust, less the expenses of the Trusts operations and other liabilities. TRXS was launched on Sep 8, 2026 and is issued by Canary.
